source_policy: Every scale must resolve to the official EleutherAI step143000 branch target. Runtime artifacts must record the loaded weight filename, byte count, and SHA-256.

pythia_410m_main_vs_step143000.comparison: Representative samples from the embedding, output head, layers 0/12/23, and final layer norm become byte-identical after the runner's bfloat16 cast (maximum absolute difference 0). The larger branch artifact is a precision-format difference, not different runtime weights.

pythia_2p8b_main_safetensors.extra_entries_description: Per-layer attention bias and masked-bias buffers

format_audit.comparison: All common tensor names, dtypes, shapes, and offsets match. Representative byte samples from embeddings, output head, layers 0/15/31, and final layer norm match exactly. The file-size difference is explained by stripped attention buffers, not a different parameter-scale architecture.
